name: Protecting Family
overview: Scripture reveals that protecting family is grounded in trusting God's steadfast presence and strength amid adversity. Believers are encouraged to be courageous and fearless because the LORD goes with them, never failing or forsaking them (Deuteronomy 31:6; Psalms 27:1). The Psalms portray God as a refuge who fights on behalf of His people, preserving and delivering them from their enemies (Psalms 35:1; 138:7). Moreover, God’s care extends especially to the vulnerable within the family and community, such as orphans and widows, underscoring His protective and preserving nature (Psalms 146:9; 91:1).
